description: This Java class RawIniFile is designed to parse and interact with INI-like configuration files. It processes lines, filters comments, and provides methods for retrieving specific configuration values based on keys.

classes.name: RawIniFile
classes.description: Main class for representing and handling INI configuration files, with methods to retrieve line data and properties based on keys.

classes.name: RawIniFile.Line
classes.description: Inner class representing a single line in the INI file, including tokenization and comment detection.

methods.name: RawIniFile
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RawIniFile with a list of processed lines and builds a map for quick lookup.

methods.name: getMandatoryLine
methods.description: Retrieves a line associated with the given key, throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: getByKey
methods.description: Returns the line associated with the specified key or null if absent.

methods.name: getLines
methods.description: Returns the list of all parsed lines.

methods.name: getSimpleIntegerProperty
methods.description: Gets the integer value of a property by key, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: getSimpleIntegerProperty
methods.description: Gets the integer value of a property by key, returning a default if not found.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns a list of string tokens (excluding the key) for a given property key.
